title: ap2-iso20022
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that bridges AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol) and x402 agent-payment mandates into wire-valid ISO 20022 pain.001 and pacs.008 records. Normalises AP2/x402 mandates, checks them, and converts to initiation and clearing/settlement messages while enforcing spending-cap, expiry and authorisation guardrails. Apache-2.0, pure Python over stdio.
